rule_or_requirement: A locally confirmed pixel-only speed controller must retain its measured behavior when built as a rule-compliant archive.
observable_information: Four grayscale frames, visible road clearance, obstacle pixels, rendered speed, and the frozen full-road-guard actor action.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Copy the exact selected control archive, replace only its entrypoint with a wrapper, and add the exact confirmed stable-risk runtime source.
expected_success_endpoint: The ZIP has a valid root agent, exact frozen control bytes, finite three-value actions, and no prohibited imports or calls.
falsifier: Changed frozen bytes, invalid archive inventory, missing dependency, runtime-limit breach, or invalid action.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Build the ZIP once, audit every member, and run a clean Linux CPU import/reset/act smoke before a separately registered fresh matched driving comparison.
resource_and_risk_gate: Local packaging within 600 seconds; no site upload, official submission, model confirmation, or reuse of confirmation cells for tuning.
